title: Digital Takes The Court For March Madness

facts.fact: Thousands of Xbox gamers took part in a Pontiac promotion that played out tournament games virtually before the real games took place.
facts.quote: have been played virtually by thousands of Xbox gamers taking part in a Pontiac promotion

facts.fact: Cingular Wireless provided a digital "halftime show" for online viewers of NCAA March Madness.
facts.quote: Cingular Wireless will be providing a digital “halftime show” for online viewers

facts.fact: State Farm sponsored a March Madness activity that helped fans generate excuses for watching games in the office.
facts.quote: State Farm will help generate excuses for fans trying to get some privacy to watch in the office.
